extraction.document_summary: This Singlife brochure explains its Direct Purchase Insurance (DPI) life insurance offering, which can be bought directly online or at a customer service centre. It presents two independently selectable base products: DIRECT – Singlife Term Life (fixed-period coverage) and DIRECT – Singlife Whole Life (lifelong coverage). Both pay a lump-sum for death-related events, including death and early payouts for terminal illness and total and permanent disability, as described in the product notes. Coverage limits differ by product (term up to S$400,000; whole life up to S$200,000), and buyers choose payment frequency. Both products may also include an optional critical illness rider that provides a lump-sum for 30 covered critical illnesses but is explicitly described as accelerating the Death Benefit of the base policy. Eligibility is stated as Singapore residents aged 19 to 65 (age next birthday).
quality_notes: Brochure clearly distinguishes DIRECT – Singlife Term Life vs DIRECT – Singlife Whole Life and provides key limits and coverage scope.
Many detailed rider benefit rules (waiting periods/exclusions) are referenced but not included in this document, so benefit-level exclusions/periods cannot be reliably extracted.
No underwriting method, free-look period, grace period, or cash value/surrender value rules are provided in a specific extract (only general notes about surrender value and cash value existence).

aliases: DIRECT – Singlife Term Life (as mentioned in brochure)
policies.quick_summary: DIRECT – Singlife Term Life is a Singlife Direct Purchase Insurance life plan you can buy directly, with optional critical-illness protection. It provides a lump-sum for death and early payouts of the Death Benefit for terminal illness and total and permanent disability. You choose coverage for a fixed period: 5-year renewable term, 20 years, or up to age 65, and it covers TPD up to the chosen coverage period or until age 65, whichever is earlier. The brochure states entry ages are 19 to 65 (age next birthday) for direct purchase, and you can choose sum assured from S$50,000 to S$400,000. Premium illustrations include S$0.32/day for S$400,000 on a 5-year renewable term (female, age 19, non-smoker).

policies.premium_payment_term_description: Premiums stay the same throughout the premium payment period (exact payment-period definition not stated in this brochure).
policies.renewal_basis: For 5-year renewable term: upon renewal, the Life Assured is insured for the same Sum Assured as before renewal and for the same policy term; premiums are adjusted based on age at renewal.
policies.bonuses_or_dividends: Brochure mentions that you can choose a plan that provides just protection or one that also comes with cash value and potential bonuses (reversionary bonus and terminal bonus), and potential bonuses are non-guaranteed.
important_caveats: Terminal Illness and Total and Permanent Disability benefits are early payouts of the Death Benefit.
DPI coverage limit per person per insurer is S$400,000 and is aggregated for all DPI term life coverage and DPI whole life coverage.
Renewal of 5-year renewable term is subject to policy terms and conditions (and the maximum age to renew DIRECT – Singlife Term Life is 80; coverage will be up to age 85).
Surrender value, if any, may be zero or less than total premiums paid on early termination (general note).

aliases: DIRECT – Singlife Whole Life (as mentioned in brochure)
policies.quick_summary: DIRECT – Singlife Whole Life is a Singlife Direct Purchase Insurance life plan that can provide lifelong protection and includes optional critical-illness coverage. The brochure says it pays a lump-sum if you die, become terminally ill, or suffer total and permanent disability, and it clarifies that terminal illness and total and permanent disability are early payouts of the Death Benefit. For whole life, death and terminal illness are covered for life, while total and permanent disability is covered up to age 65. The sum assured range stated for whole life is S$50,000 to S$200,000. Premiums can be paid monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly, and the premium illustration shown is S$4.13/day for a S$200,000 sum assured Whole Life plan with premiums paid until age 85.

DPI whole life maximum sum assured stated as S$200,000; DPI coverage limit per person per insurer is S$400,000 aggregated for term and whole life.
General brochure note: early termination may involve high costs and surrender value, if any, may be zero or less than total premiums paid.
